why: Shell cycle 3 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-3.md, P1 shell-3.1): the docked aside shows a record the URL no longer names. From `?team=payments&service=checkout&deploy=checkout-093`, the crumb parent or the rail link to Services unsets `deploy`, yet the aside stays docked on "Deploy v3.13.0" until Close panel. Picking Billing keeps `deploy=checkout-093`, and Checkout's record sits beside Billing's table (`.evidence/cycle-shell-3/stale.log` S1, S2, S4; `parent.log` P3-1800). Cause: a shown detail holds the aside open whatever its bound field says (`src/page/page-aside.tsx:176-180`, `isOpen = detail !== null || (open ?? wide)`). The table that showed the detail hides it only while it is mounted (`src/table/use-data-table.ts:405-412`), and a SplitPage detail pane unmounts the table when the selection clears. On a switch of the `resetOn` key the table skips its re-check, because the open id still equals the shown one (`use-data-table.ts:413`).
what: The aside never shows a record its bound field does not name: a navigation that unsets the field closes it, and a table whose rows reset drops an open id they lack.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/table/use-data-table.ts (the detailState effect and its cleanup) and its tests
packages/basalt-ui/docs/page-aside.md, packages/basalt-ui/docs/use-data-table.md (only where the behaviour is described)
change:
Three parts:
- A `PageAside` bound to `state` hides the detail shown in it when its field unsets: a docked aside closes with its field (`page-aside.tsx`).
- A `useDataTable` with `detailState` hides the detail it showed when it unmounts, so a pane that drops the table drops its record (`use-data-table.ts`).
- A change of `resetOn` re-checks the open id against the new rows: an id they lack is cleared, as a URL id with no loaded row already is (`use-data-table.ts:413`).
commits: fix: commits in packages/basalt-ui, granular (aside follows its field, table hides on unmount, resetOn re-check).
proof: make check; a layout test at 1800 that opens a record from a SplitPage detail table, then (a) navigates the crumb parent, (b) navigates a rail link to the same route, (c) picks another list item, and finds no aside after each.
acceptance: After a navigation that unsets the bound field, the docked aside is closed (layout test)
A table that unmounts while its record is shown leaves no record in the aside (test)
A `resetOn` change whose new rows lack the open id clears the field and the aside (test)
out_of_scope: The crumb's aria-current and focus after a crumb click (v3-shell-3-shell).
